notes.title: Patch 2.1 will include improved graphics
notes.content:
Greetings fellow doctors!

Today I'm announcing you the new patch for General Practitioner, which will fix more issues with the game and introduce a new 2560x1440 max resolution.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/f4835521e8d0eade9b66ec49956eb1670c9240ca.jpg[/img]

The game is more than 4 years old now, and while a Visual Novel doesn't need 2k or 4k graphic to be enjoyable, that is not the reason why GP is just 1280x720 pixel.

When I started developing this game back in 2017 I had a very limited hardware and relied on sending the images to render to an external website with a very slow internet connection as well! In time I improved my hardware and started developing games in 1920x1080 which is now the standard resolution I use in Yomi Alliance and other games as well.

General Practitioner isn't aging very well in 1280, so I decided to upgrade it a little.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/d1fa35c37c05d827b6b44842fc0175f166c423e0.jpg[/img]

You can see some differences above. The overall look of the game is less grainy and colors are more intense, especially on newer monitors. Some images benefit from that more than others, but the game has been improved throughout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/4ed64025537866c30bce1f2b5f2c3ccd8f4d592e.jpg[/img]

This doesn't mean I re-rendered all the images in 2k resolution, but it means the older images have been upscaled with an IA to add pixels and preserve the original aspect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/23df377a80661e2385ee618e78c56d672bf04bec.jpg[/img]

This will also mean that the newest DLCs will get the new resolution right from the start, improving the quality of each release.

I am also planning to re-do some of the very old images and those which definitely need some re-doing, but that will come on a later patch. Of course the user interface has been upscaled as well.

I hope you'll enjoy the new graphic for the game when 2.1 will be out, ideally in a couple weeks.

Stay safe and healthy, and thank you for your support!

notes.title: Emergency Procedures update 1.16 will be out in a few weeks!
notes.content:
Greetings fellow doctors!

It's with great pleasure and joy that I'm announcing you the newest, big update and DLC for General Practitioner: Emergency Procedures! The update features a lot of bugfixes and improvements, as well as preparing the game for the DLC itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/1cb62fdb34d1428db7f760c1c3c64ddfcb13f1b9.png[/img]

In Emergency Procedures you will enjoy more of the Doctor's personal story with [b]two new romance options[/b] (one male, one female) and many new dialogues and situations.

Enjoy 15 new Emergency cases from drug addicts, to COVID-19 related issues, to sudden death where you can do nothing but relieve the relatives' pain with your human skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/5f640c802174ec433b14ba6f1e50655f5540a5b1.jpg[/img]

You can play the DLC with 2 different difficulty levels: as a "medical Student" you will be guided in each of your steps, explaining to you what to do next in each case. If you want to experience real doctor simulation opt in for the "Doctor" for the maximum challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/c1cb91cfb56bc027c8d4f318059ea20fb24eb207.jpg[/img]

We also provided new music tracks to enjoy during this DLC, to better immerse you in the Doctor's world, and provided new sex scenes to entertain those of you who don't like to play in Vanilla Mode (the game mode without any sexual content.

Oh, and did I mention you can choose between new haircuts and looks for the doctor to play from this DLC and now on? Meaning your choices will impact the future releases of the game. However, due to the nature of the game's rendering engine, you can't change the look of the doctor for the main story mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/746b2f436be00075898ebd119e13bcc7aa79981d.jpg[/img]

I hope you'll like both the update and the DLC. Your support is still, and always will be, the only way I can keep making games for your entertainment.

Stay safe, and healthy.

notes.title: Hotel Paris is the next Otome Visual Novel
notes.content:
Greetings guys!

Today I'm announcing the next upcoming game, an Otome Visual Novel set in Paris!

I am quite fond of this little project, as it tries to bring something new as well as the other games of my small studio, even if this is the most "classic" Visual Novel to date (and the first not "Adult only" in my catalog, in a way similar to The Coroner Saga (which episode IV is set to be released at more or less the same time!)

The main features for "Hotel Paris" which will have you take the shoes of Elizabeth, discovering her story and choosing her romantic interests, are the following:

[list]
[*] A brand-new, 30k word long Otome Visual Novel
[*] Choose between 3 different romantic interests, or pursue your happiness on your own
[*] 4 different endings
[*] Full French Localization
[*] Choose between Realistic and Anime-like graphic for the characters. You can switch graphic mode with a single button click anytime!
[*] Original Soundtrack of 10 tracks!
[*] 2560x1440 HD graphic with more than 200 images
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/cdc4c26c92b543f1dee4d6365ee078d2c5723a9a.png[/img]

The most interesting feature of the game is your ability to switch from Anime-like graphic to the usual "realistic" graphic my other games offer. Whatever fits your taste, you will like what's in store for you in the game, and you can choose it without the need to restart the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/2ed64b0df3bbe9dd91dbe33b9324a0f2eba63da8.png[/img]

I humbly thank you for following me and my games, and I hope you'll have fun with Hotel Paris as well!

Please remember to add it to your wishlist to further help me spread the news!

Be safe and healthy.

ANDREA

notes.content:
Greetings!

Getting to work to General Practitioner is always lovely, and also a little strange. This is the first game I made with Ren'Py and there are lots of things I am not doing nowadays, either because I learned how to use the engine properly, and also because I found more efficient ways to do things.

[b]VISUAL NOVEL MODE[/b]
You can now start a new game in Visual Novel Mode, meaning you will play the story without medical examinations, moving from one chapter to the next one and choosing who to pursue as a romantic interest.

We made every effort to give players who already tried the game once to experiment more paths in a simpler way.

Whenever a "RED" dialogue option appears, it means that's a "Path Point", meaning you will choose the romantic partner with that dialogue and that choice will accompany you through the rest of the game. You cannot change the romantic path once started (the "Story Mode" will keep allowing you to do so, this is limited to Visual Novel mode only).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/bc6fa889c1864232b4f804231125e0b1cc12f0ca.png[/img]

Dialogues with Rita have changed, a new ending has been added as well as two different events and sexual situations. Explore the new path in both Story and Visual Novel mode!

[b]NEW MEDICAL EXAMINATION: KAVITHA[/b]
As a reward for pledging on our patreon page, you can write down and ask for a medical exam to be introduced in the game. Kavitha is such a reward and you can enjoy her medical examination helped by a medical student named Jamal.

For the others I suggest you to grab a copy during the upcoming summer sales, as the game will receive a nice discount! The new price for the game will be 19,99$ (and regional equivalents) starting from after the Summer Sales. Of course this doesn't apply to current owners of the game.

Thanks a lot for your understanding!

notes.title: Yomi Alliance is going in Early Access on February 10th
notes.content:
Yomi Alliance is about to hit the shelves of Steam's Early Access in a few days, on February 10, as scheduled.

While the game is in its very first steps of development - the current release version is 0.0.3 - it already goes with a lot of content, mostly story-related, with the first differences between professions and species that will come out while playing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/4fbed326b9ce41873a56531da0c4c0fc4a93b67f.jpg[/img]

The final release is scheduled in 2021. Game features will be added month after month and the released game already has different paths to explore. Still, the full potential of the game will be unleashed in a matter of months.

[b]Supporting the Early Access game will allow me to keep producing more exciting content for you[/b], as of course my studio is very (very) small and developing a videogame certainly costs a lot. That's why Early Accesses are released, and that's why supporting them helps all developers - but [b]especially indie ones[/b] - a lot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/802df3f2cf65cc547312e7fd7a2d759c67e4af7a.png[/img]

[b]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/b]
[list]
[*] Command School Training is complete
[*] Science School Training is complete 
[*] Each training lasts 20 weeks (in-game time)
[*] Lectures at the Academy with skills improvement
[*] About 10 hours of gameplay including different paths to explore for each career
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Different Serena Conversations in her quarters
[*] Soundtrack fully implemented and working
[*] Animations, where present, are fully implemented
[*] Working animate multitask console to access Academy's systems
[*] User interface is 75% complete
[*] Administration classes
[*] Athletics classes with challenges
[*] Computer Use classes
[*] Armed Combat classes with simulated fights against different enemies
[*] Inquire classes with sub-plot
[*] Negotiate classes with sub-plot
[*] Persuasion classes
[*] Psychology classes for Counselor Career
[*] 10 different conversations with Serena
[*] 4 different dates with Serena with sex animations
[*] Each profession unlocked (classes for each skill are still under development)
[*] 10 different "Academy Storyline" events
[*] 1215 static Full-HD images, 7 FULL-HD animations
[*] 18 different upbringings to customize your character and starting skills
[/list]

Grabbing the Early Access also has another advantage, as the final release will be priced about 50% higher than the current one, being it filled with a lot of new content. Early Access price could also increase in time for the same reason.

Grabbing the game at Early Access launch (with a launch discount too!) will ensure you'll get all the updates as soon as they're released, so it's the best deal if you like our games and want something different.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/3b4bb68d009687388d0b1a27c62e4dcad8e680fb.png[/img]

[b]Will this be much like General Practitioner?[/b]

The level of complexity for the choice/consequence and different playthrough will be as high as GP, but there won't be any repetitive tasks in Yomi Alliance. It's more a RPG while GP was more of a simulator kind of game.

You will be asked to choose your weekly schedule, but besides that you'll be free to live your own story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/dd83a91afaa65c1c5e17c33d0405861514f1807d.png[/img]

Thank you for following the game's development, I hope you'll enjoy Yomi Alliance. It's a bold project, as it was GP when I started developing it, but with your support every challenge is worth facing!

Be safe and healthy, see you out there!

notes.content:
An update for General Practitioner is available for download!

[b]Bug fixing[/b]

[list]
[*] Clicking anywhere when displaying a dialogue during online shopping won't result in accidental selections anymore
[*] Fixed an issue which made the game refer to male children as "girl"

[*] Winning the most difficult challenge against Koola in the gym will now grant you 1000$ as intended (from 100)
[*] Fixed a crashing issue during Dwayne's examination
[*] Fixed an inconsistency with a dialogue line from "Living Together" chapter if you didn't invite Claudia to the Festival
[*] Fixed an inconsistent line of dialogue regarding a promise you made to Claudia if you never made it in the first place
[*] Fixed inconsistencies during Medical Board's advice on Kamil's first examination

[*] Fixed a calendar issue which caused the calendar to calculate the wrong day in January
[*] Fixed an issue which caused an incorrect timeframe after Trip to Japan and Trip to Canada
[*] A number of graphical glitches have been fixed
[*] Removed a redundant, incorrect diagnosis in Elliott's exam
[*] Fixed an image inconsistency during Joy's Festival (Erika's path) by adding two different images
[*] Fixed a wrong prescription text in Josh's 2nd exam
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented to examine Kelli's legs in her exam
[*] A rare issue involving achievements is currently under investigation. I reset all the "persistent" entries trying to fix this one, but I cannot grant previously-earned achievements that were affected by the issue. It looks like the issue affects players who played the Alpha release more than others. You can try to manually reset the achievements by deleting the "persistent" file in your "save" folder. Please note that doing this will also reset your ending (meaning the "New Game+" option will be locked again) and any customized setting (i.e. fullscreen, skip options, vanilla mode etc.)
[*] It was reported that, in very rare cases, saved games could behave erratically after applying this patch (i.e. right-clicking, hitting ESC not working properly). I made a fix to try to overcome this issue, even though the error appears so randomly that it's almost impossible to understand its origin. Still, new games are not affected by it and you should be able to play the game by loading it without problems. To achieve that I had to reset any customized setting (i.e. fullscreen, skip options, vanilla mode etc.), sorry for any discomfort this might cause.
[b]In case you are still affected by the issue just try and reload an earlier saved game. The problem has been reported to disappear just like it appeared.
Checking the game's integrity with the Steam's client is also recommended in case of any trouble.[/b]
[*] Claudia will no longer be seen sleeping with the Doctor after she moves to Germany
[*] Fixed inconsistencies with Erika's advice during some random examinations
[*] Fixed an issue with Vanessa/Aaron not recognizing you got a car when you have
[*] Fixed Newscaster stating the security guard was being shot even though she wasn't during Conrad's exam
[*] After beating Mr. Xuan in Tang Soo Do you will no longer run errands for him nor training with Kiko when starting a new day
[/list]

[b]Gameplay changes[/b]

[list]
[*] A new medical examination music has been added to random patients
[*] The waiting room will now open on May 5th, regardless of the patients you already examined
[*] Rita's, Kiko's and Julius' exams are no longer skippable as they are mandatory for the game's consistency. You will automatically go to the clinic when it's time to examine them.
[*] End credits will now take the player to the Main Menu instead of quitting the game
[*] Mr. Ellis' name is no longer case-sensitive when you have to type it to recognize him
[*] The Interactive phone has been restored from earlier alpha builds.
[*] You can now click on the "Stairs" icon to exit the clinic without making any clinic-related choice or have to hit the return button
[*] New Game+ has been introduced in the game. To unlock it you will need to finish the game at least once (up to the point where end credits are shown) and to Start a new game. The game will then ask you if you wish to start from scratch or from a New game plus.

New Game+ retains your money, medical items bought, relationship levels with every potential romance (except Christina) and skills. It will also unlock the Waiting Room right from the beginning. 
It will NOT include people you met in the game nor already performed exams and events. Other events (pool subscription, gym subscription, Norah's meeting) are not unlocked.

[*] An option to choose which chapter to play has been added to the game.

You can go to the Church to "Meditate on your life" and choose a specific chapter to jump to, even previously played ones. 

Please be aware that skipping makes the game to assume certain choices have been made by default. As the in-game calendar isn't updated (that's because events can play in different days depending on choices), it also advances events ahead of time, so you could end up playing the "Christmas Dinner" event in June for example. I recommend you to use it after you finished the game at least once.

Also, many events that depend on your romance paths (i.e. Elisa's whole pregnancy story) are not available to skip upon, since not setting the proper variables would cause the game to behave erratically. 
Ultimately, this feature is not the proper way to play the game and it could lead to unexpected behavior.

[*] Added the "Experienced Doctor" achievement unlockable by starting a New Game Plus
[/list]


Thank you for playing the game!

notes.title: Dealing with a very rare, elusive, completely random bug
notes.content:
It's almost 3 AM and I just finished wrapping up the latest bug fixes for release 1.3, and there are many fixes you'll find "minor" but are somewhat important to the overall experience of the game.

A few days ago I released 1.3 but had to remove it almost immediately because of some issues it was giving to some players. We're talking about 10 people out of a few hundred, so the numbers are very few, nevertheless I put on a Beta branch and I'm still trying to figure out what caused the issue in the first place.

It was reported that, in very rare cases, saved games could behave erratically after applying this patch (i.e. right-clicking, hitting ESC not working properly). 
I made a fix to try to overcome this issue, even though the error appears so randomly that it's almost impossible to understand its origin. Still, new games are not affected by it and you should be able to play the game by loading it without problems. To achieve that I had to reset any customized setting (i.e. fullscreen, skip options, vanilla mode etc.) upon loading a game saved before 1.3, sorry for any discomfort this might cause.

In case you are still affected by the issue after I release the patch: 
[list]
[*] just try and reload an earlier saved game. The problem has been reported to disappear just like it appeared.
[*] Checking the game's integrity with the Steam's client is also recommended in case of any trouble.
[/list]

While some of you might even laugh at a developer who can't find his own bugs, I assure you this is more slippery than it seems, because of the few people actually affected and because every game I tried, even after loading allegedly corrupted games was completely bug-free.

Of course I could also tell you that older saves are incompatible and that would be it. Many games actually do it after major releases (i.e. Stellaris, to name one) and I believe that's fine, but it wouldn't be true, because loading a game actually works for most people!

Since the issue wasn't reported for a while, I decided to release 1.3 tomorrow, as it brings so many new features I'm very excited to share with you. 

Just tell me if you experience the bug by writing at bugs(at)brunimultimedia.com after trying the above solutions. Thank you for enjoying the game, I hope you'll have fun with it for a long time.

ANDREA

notes.title: New Game+ and Chapter Selection
notes.content:
Greetings fellow doctors!

[b]General Practitioner launch was a huge success for the game[/b], I really didn't expect so many people would've played the game and for a very small software house like mine (I'm basically developing the whole game by myself) it's a very exciting surprise!

Of course, [b]releasing the game also brought some issues[/b], as the many months of alpha and beta testing were apparently not enough to cancel every bug from the game. Still, the game is very big and with lots of branches and choices and it took me some time to find and fix everything. This is NOT an excuse but a sincere explanation of what happened in the first few days.

[b]I apologize for any discomfort you might have experienced while playing the game.[/b]

[b]I already released a number of fixes which took care of the most annoying bugs[/b] (the first one on the very first day of release) and reports of annoyed players dropped a lot.

[b]I am also listening to your feedback[/b] of course, because like I promised General Practitioner is not being abandoned after release, on the contrary you can expect a lot of free patches and DLCs in the future.

With the upcoming 1.3 patch I'm going to release in a few hours more bugs will be solved. Not only that: [b] I'm also introducing two new functions to the game[/b]:

[b]New Game Plus[/b]
To unlock this feature you will need to finish the game at least once (up to the point where end credits are shown) and start a new game. A menu prompt will then ask you if you wish to start from scratch or from a New game plus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/127d42ac4fcc5224b3c54359943b36a1eb895747.png[/img]

New Game+ retains the following informations for your new game:
[list]
[*] Money
[*] Medical Items owned
[*] Relationship Levels with Romance partners (except Christina)
[*] Skills
[*] Waiting Room unlocks
[/list]

It will NOT include people you met in the game nor already performed exams and events as they are part of the story. For the same reason other events such as pool subscription, gym subscription, Norah's meeting etc., are not unlocked.

[b]Chapter Selection[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/22e7af63a1cefc86cb791d50a99c680ab35b3e9f.png[/img]

An option to choose which chapter to play has been added to the game.

You can go to the Church to "Meditate on your life" and choose a specific chapter to jump to, even previously played ones. 

Please be aware that skipping makes the game to assume certain choices have been made by default. As the in-game calendar isn't updated (that's because events can play in different days depending on choices), it also advances events ahead of time, so you could end up playing the "Christmas Dinner" event in June for example. I recommend you to use it after you finished the game at least once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/3d8acca8e86be181593db1083b52c89971927039.png[/img]

Also, many events that depend on your romance paths (i.e. Elisa's whole pregnancy story) are not available to skip upon, since not setting the proper variables would cause the game to behave erratically. 

Ultimately, this feature is not the proper way to play the game and it could lead to unexpected behavior. Still, if you wish to play chapters you never saw in your first playthrough without needing to re-play the whole game, this feature is what you're looking for.

New chapters will be added in future updates, so stay tuned.

[b]I hope you're enjoying the game, I'm working hard on it and on Yomi Alliance as well, to bring you dozens of hours of fun. If you enjoy your time with my games, then my goal has been reached![/b]

Be safe and healthy,

ANDREA

notes.title: DEVELOPMENT LOG #29: City and Clinic Map
notes.content:
Greetings fellow doctors!

Amongst the final changes made to the game I'm reviewing the User Interface. Too many people believe this is something less important than actual gameplay or story script, while I learned from the best developers that it's a very important part of the game, just like a good musical score!

One of the oldest interfaces in the game was the "Daily Choice Screen" and the "Clinic Choice Screen". Basically you had to click once onto the clinic, then another screen would appear and you had to choose again what to do.

While navigating the city the screens could even be more than two, making the whole operation very annoying for some players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/e15313f705e1ab9bc05cf5e1aa7db398e334df32.png[/img]

0.0.30 update will feature two brand-new maps: the city map (so that you can have an idea on how the city the doctor's lives in looks like) and the clinic map, showing you what it means to be inside St. Mary's clinic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/ce13834f16934d048a39a34cd786a85a879edfdd.png[/img]

A tooltip will of course appear while moving the mouse over an icon, showing you what will happen if you choose a specific place.

I hope you'll like this small but important improvement of the game!

Be safe and healthy, thank you for being with me in this journey!

notes.title: DEVLOG #28: All good things...
notes.content:
[b]All good things must come to an end...[/b] And that's not as easy as it might seem.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/cc47dbb29f9dc5ec4c47d5610dc8b52329969c4a.jpg[/img]

General Practitioner is approaching its 30th major patch release on Patreon and soon it will be available for every player as well. We're in the middle of finalizing the script, adding images and fixing the most obvious bugs, which is a bigger step in development than many might think.

0.0.30 will also mark the last Alpha Release of the game, which will enter Beta in November with 0.1.0 and finally in final release in December. I took many decisions about the game and here I am announcing them to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/577f90a61ef6678713200fc416b5092cceb4a217.jpg[/img]

First of all, [b]I had to draw a line[/b]: many improvements can still be made in the game's story, so much content can still be added (side stories for other characters, more patients, more items in the store, etc.) and many will be added when Beta hits the shelves! Still, [b]I think it's also time to finalize the game in its current state[/b], taking a full month to polish it from bugs and other issues (which are very minor right now) and seeing how the game can walk on its own.

This of course means that I had to cut something that just wasn't working properly in terms of script and gameplay. 

[list]
[*] The "Gallery" feature will be removed from the Main Menu as it was never properly developed and most people have no use for it (you can take a screenshot of everything in the game hiding the interface by pressing "H" on your keyboard).
[*] Father Torque's "mission" was added in 0.0.4 but it doesn't add anything to the Doctor's story, character or choices. While I also wrote the examination for the road worker guy you're supposed to steal underwear from, it just didn't work. And sometimes we, as writers, need to accept something we're writing is not fitting the whole opera and cut it out.
[*] The settings screen won't show support for other languages anymore. Unfortunately we never reached our crowdfunding goal to start translating the game in any language, and GP will stay an english-only Visual Novel for the time being (it was never posted anywhere around the game's promotional pages that a localization would be added, to be honest).
[*] Some endings will be rewritten to fit the new content added in 0.0.30, which means the "main story" of the game. If you thought the endings were only bad ones, that's because they lacked some part of the story, especially Claudia's and Erika's
[/list]

While [b]we started the preliminary work on our newest project[/b] (you will see the details very soon, and [b]we'll need your help with its kickstarter[/b]), this doesn't mean General Practitioner will cease updates from December, on the contrary it will receive patches, new DLCs (most of them free) with new content and many updates for months or even years to come!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/1c1c89c5ed67d2ee6dead7133f3f7f34309de851.png[/img]

[b]We love this project, it's our firstborn Visual Novel, and we'll keep updating it beyond it's final release. 

So stay with us, keep following us and, if you like what we're doing in our Visual Novels, keep supporting our work![/b]

We hope you'll enjoy our game's updates as we're enjoying developing them!

notes.title: Development Log #23: The Bank, The Garage, The Bonding Place
notes.content:
Greetings fellow doctors!

In this very hot summer, at least in southern Europe, I thought about giving you some fresh news for you to enjoy!

Today I'm introducing you some new places to enjoy in the game, which will be delivered with update 0.0.27 which is about to be published for our Patreon supporters and in a few weeks for everyone as well!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/126d34dcd90e4f008209c601f71bba619bf630c2.png[/img]

All these places are tied to your relationship with Vanessa and Aaron, so you will only discover them by going through your relationship with them. Also, since they introduce new ways to get money and stats, they are also introduced quite late into the game to avoid breaking its balance.

The first place is [b]the Bank[/b] where Aaron works. You can go there to either talk with him (26 conversations have been added for both him and Vanessa, and they are not just the same ones repeating themselves, but are different lines who reflect the characters) or to use the bank services (i.e. [u]Loans[/u])

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/d9fb46de57e39fcdeb6b4c0a97c5bf950182a519.png[/img]

For a monthly fee you can get up to 100k $ to spend at the clinic, buying cars, paying staff members etc. You can only have the higher loans if your clinic has enough fame though, as the bank won't just give money to some unknown guy who needs it.

If you fail to repay the monthly fee you will lose A LOT of fame, so think about loans if you feel like paying them back!

The second place is [b]the Garage[/b], where Aaron or Vanessa (depending on who you chose on January to be your "Main Romantic Interest") will tweak cars for a price. And being you their partner you are offered a discount!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/2ee372aef0d5c036e4a5b043881bb8516d8cd013.png[/img]

If you own one or more cars/bykes, you can bring them there to be customized and earn some benefits.
[list]
[*] Adding ***ADS*** will cost you 4500$ and will boost your fame by 15 points each month.
[*] Modifying the ***ENGINE*** will cost you 10000$ and reduce the energy you need to move around to 0.
[*] Adding ***LED LIGHTS*** will cost you 3500$ and will boost your charm by 5 each month.
[*] You can do this for more than one vehicle, and the effects will stack.
[*] Each time you ask for a customization your relationship with Aaron/Vanessa will increase significantly.
[*] However, since they are self-learning mechanics, there is also a 3% chance they will damage your vehicle permanently.
[/list]

The final place is the [b]Bonding Place[/b], a place where you can play around with Aaron, Vanessa or both (yeah, threesomes!) and establish new bonds with them ;)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/8033d21f5d609e24a9d3f4a23d3928d1b02a3f9b.png[/img]

Unlocking a dozen new sex images and two brand new animations, you can go to the Bonding Place to earn some sexperience and progress your relationship with both Aaron and Vanessa, at least until they're satisfied of this kind of menage-a-trois.

Let me know what you think about this new additions, I can't do a good game without the players' support and feedback!

Be safe, healthy and be careful about the hot weather!

notes.content:
Hello fellow doctors!

The long-awaited update nicknamed [b]"Colleagues, Lovers"[/b] will be shipped in a few weeks while crowdfunders on Patreon will be able to play it a few days earlier.

[b]This update will focus on Erika's romance[/b], with brand-new events and situations involving our favourite nurse! It also features[b] three new medical exams[/b] which are a little different from what you're familiar with in terms of both situations and gameplay (at least for the "Story" event).

[b]New animations[/b] have been added to sexual situations, some of which are new on their own. The update is about three hours long in gameplay and I'm sure you'll like all the situations and high-definition pictures it brings along!

Lacey's examination, which you can see in the picture above, has been written and requested by one of our Patreon crowdfunders, a 30$ patron with the "Character request" reward of my page!

If you wish to request a specific exam for the game while also supporting our projects join our 30$ tier on Patreon. A full list of rewards is available on our [url=https://www.patreon.com/generalpractitioner][b]Patreon's Main Page[/b][/url].

I hope you'll enjoy playing this update, as I really enjoyed writing it. The most fascinating stories can be written with these characters with hardly any repetition, since they all possess their own well-established characters and dreams and each of them has its own background!

notes.title: 0.0.24 will feature poligamy, jealousy and more!
notes.content:
Hello guys!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/36226d33199daec792571ba1e25a3acdabd54302.jpg[/img]

It's been a while since I posted news about the game's development (well, not so much but I'm usually faster in releasing news), and that's because I underwent a big deal to deliver as much updates in-game as possible.

While work on 0.0.23 is undergoing as planned, [b]we're also working to contents for 0.0.24 ("No Ordinary Family") as well[/b], and those of you who read the roadmap to the final release will already know this means... [b]"Claudia content!"[/b]

[b]0.0.24 will feature a full romance playthrough with her[/b], from the start of your relationship until its ending(s), based on your choices along the way. This also means that the game will end on April 30th, which is the last in-game day for the full release coming up on December. Of course activities from January to April will only be based on Claudia right now, but with each upcoming update this will change and all the other characters will be included as well!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/46242f1bf5830d7adf7a9ec5993ef2a86ff79848.jpg[/img]

Many gameplay features will be revealed in the upcoming weeks, but today I can introduce you to three different mechanics: [b]jealousy, poligamy and household activities[/b]!

[b]Jealousy [/b]is conceptually linked to [b]poligamy[/b]: many players asked to be able to date more than one character at once. That will be possible, even though for gameplay reasons you will be able to live with one person at a time, while also dating others though.

Each character will then have a chance to "catch you red-handed" and behave accordingly. [b]For example, if you are dating Rita and bring Christina to a date to the Icecream shop Rita's working in... well, you are not very smart! [/b]

However, even walking on the beach might trigger a random encounter with your (other) significant one, possibly leading to an argument thereafter.
[b]Each character will react to this in his/her own different way[/b]. Erika might be understanding of you having a coffee with your relative, while Vanessa might understand your bond with Erika (after all you're working together), but Claudia might not like Rita at all and argue with you about her.
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/0c76762fe3bc91ba171832e5ca706f9fb067c56d.png[/img]

It's up to you to explore the different combinations, while also keeping an eye about your relationship with your significant other. If relationships falls too much you might be dumped and find yourself masturbating alone in your bed in no time!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/8fa449a73b696060c1e367e2736025a613655a30.jpg[/img]

Yes, because among other "[b]household activities[/b]" you'll also be able to masturbate to get sexperience and more! The old "Relax" button will be replaced with a "Stay at home" button which will open up a new series of activities to perform at home:

[list]
[*] Relax to regain energy
[*] Play a musical instrument to increase your charm
[*] Spend some time with your romance (if living together)
[*] Study Medicine to increase knowledge
[*] Masturbate
[*] Have a shower
[*] Watch TV
[*] Watch a porn movie (choosing the genre from six different ones to meet your romance's taste which you have to guess)
[*] Play a videogame
[/list]
 
[b]These activities will be performed either alone or with your roommate, depending on the activity itself and your relationship level with them.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/71188eb1031313bd5fd2233eac012ae0935c734d.jpg[/img]

Some players argued that having a shower takes a whole morning/afternoon/evening which is not realistic. This is a gameplay choice since the main option is "Stay at home" while the chosen activity is but a slice of what you did while staying at home. Since [b]General Practitioner has 365 days of gameplay, thus about 1090 different daily choices throughout the game[/b], having the player micromanage his time at home would have meant a big "grind-fest" we're not going to deliver, so that's why you can only choose one activity at a time.

I hope you'll enjoy 0.0.24 and it's features and you keep having fun playing the game!

Thank you for supporting the game!

Be safe and healthy,

It was reported a bug during Robyn's examination not showing the correct amount of points earned.
This is not a bug but it's working as intended. The "Examination Review" screen is related to the Medical Board's score, i.e. the way you performed the examination according to the Board's guidelines. Every other interaction with the patient (every patient in the game) might or might not affect your score in its own way, thus improving the overall result of the examination itself. Those are not present in the examination review screen but will affect your performance in an unknown way.

This has been made to simulate real life as best as possible, where a doctor who made the perfect examination on a patient could find situations where that's not enough. Likewise a doctor who performed less examination than it was necessary could get a very good reputation just because of his social skills (this also happens).

This also applies to the same report about Kiko's examination.

Thank you for playing the game!

Be safe and healthy!

notes.title: 2018 Recap - 2019 Preview
notes.content:
Hello guys!

This is the last day of the year and it's time to recollect what was achieved over Bruni Multimedia's project in this year, and have a first look of what's coming up next year as well!

[list]
[*] Random Examinations were released on March, making a first step to an almost countless replayability once they end their development in a few weeks with 0.0.22 update. Random examinations' development was made possible by Patrons pledgers who supported the game and made this goal achievable.

[*] We celebrated our first anniversary of development on General Practitioner on May. A special edition of the game was released for Patrons only which contained a sexual examination of pregnant Elisa and Erika. Some of the assets for that exam, which was dropped in August update, were re-used for the real Elisa examination

[*] Game's development became hindered in June, since I had become badly ill and couldn't work for the whole month. This meant the update scheduling suffered a change while it also gained an increase of the overall content.

[*] We officially launched the Early Access on Steam on October. This helped us to dramatically increase the player base of the game and its community. That allowed us to better understand game's mechanics, sort out bugs faster and re-draw those parts of the game which were not working at all.

[*] We are making the game moddable by the Steam Workshop, adding more layers of customization to players who might like to play the examination they always wished to play since they first tried the game.
[/list]

Those achievements have been made possible by us (developers) working together with you  (the community), because your show of love and support is what makes this worthwhile and will allow us to continue with this and other projects as well.

Since game's development is now proceeding steadily, we also had the chance and opportunity to work with many talented artists, and we also had an increase in the size of our team recently.

In 2019 we're going to launch TWO more different projects thanks to this, as we can have separate teams working on separate projects and this allows us to deliver quality games without altering the schedule of General Practitioner.

With this I'd like to introduce you Bruni Multimedia's team members.

[list]
[*] [b]JD Glass[/b] - Lead Writer of the upcoming Visual Novel (details next week!)
[*] [b]Avery Flannigan[/b] - Writer and Japanese Adaptator
[*] [b]Laura "sasquatchii" Henderson[/b] - Graphic Designer and Lead Artist
[*] [b]Ann Sharova[/b] - Lead Composer for General Practitioner
[/list]

We're also hiring a new developer, who is still uncredited for now, to allow us to release many exciting games in the future!

[b]Work on General Practitioner is proceeding as scheduled.[/b]

[b]Visual Novel Project #1[/b]'s details will follow next week!

[b]Visual Novel Project #2[/b] will be posted on Kickstarter as well, since it is a very ambitious project. I'm sure you will like it! Of course you can choose to stick to Patreon support as well, or to wait for the Steam Release to support its development... Details will follow on late February.

All Bruni Multimedia's Visual Novels feature a deep and engaging narration, adult game elements and gameplay features which make them easily recognizable. [b]If you enjoyed playing GP, just wait to see what's in store for you![/b]

Our warmest thanks to you guys, our wonderful player community!

notes.title: Development Log #6: New Medical Exams Features
notes.content:
Hi guys.

Today I'll tell you about the new Medical Exams interface and overhauled "Exam Help" setting.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/b97feef46c585829206da694291f5ac42e1a721e.jpg[/img]

Whenever you choose a medical exam, being it from the brand new waiting room or by choosing a patient from the "Exam Mode" screen, the game will pop up an ID card for that patient, explaining the main characteristics of him/her such as ID (I'll come back to this right away), Difficulty, Type of Exam (Scripted/Random), Age and Ailment.

The Difficulty is tightly related to the "Medical Aid" setting of the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/73d3d3b1943d3a65a2f4a765ee4e6633ca0370aa.jpg[/img]

With this setting enabled the game will help you diagnose a patient and choose the correct prescription for him/her, provided your character's Knowledge Level is at least as high as the number shown in parenthesis (in the above image 45).

Difficulties for exams are:

[list]
[*]Very easy 5-20
[*]Easy 25-35
[*]Normal 40-60
[*]Hard 65-80
[*]Very Hard 85-95
[/list]

This will help each player to understand the knowledge and difficulties of the exam and help him choose to be helped or not by the game.

Enabling the Medical Aid shows two new icons next to the answers for both anamnesis and prescription. Icons represent the two most likely correct answers and make easier for the player to choose one of them as the correct one.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/ec0cf8f339a5440a621548530086a301c22d81fb.jpg[/img]

Another important info is the patient ID Number. This is an unique 10-digit number that identifies each patient within the game.

You can use this ID to play (or re-play) each examination in the game, both in Story mode and in Exam mode. The game will prompt you to choose if you want to visit the exam room or use your computer to access a specific patient ID.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/f396e880e86dea5eaac84906ce2f083fc57a6dfd.jpg[/img]

Then, you will be prompted to insert the proper ID, which you can find in the Codex for each patient (you can't copypaste that since this doesn't work on Ren'py's input screens).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/1bc66e6088b47e606de515f9599cbe6fac9b3ba3.jpg[/img]

You have to put only numbers in the field, ignoring every other character (such as the "P" for Patient you can sometimes see in the game).

If you input an invalid ID the game will inform you and prompt again to the screen. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/8f77b439d5bf5f513152a57b1814a999192cb642.jpg[/img]

If you input a valid ID the game will load that specific exam.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/b855dee3e84944a214204056f67f4f4ae37d3ff5.jpg[/img]

This has been included in the game for several reasons:

[list]

[*]It allows replayability of a specific exam to score it 100% without having to reload every time
[*]It allows to boost one's money or relationships without the need for cheating
[*]It allows players to replay their favourite exams
[*]It allows players to play a specific exam they are curious about
[*]When releasing an update it allows players to play specific exams while still in story mode
[*]It paves the way for modding, as Workshop content's patients will have their own unique ID every creator will give them thus ensuring uniqueness for each one and compatibility between custom contents, it also allows to play custom content at will, both in Exam Mode and in Story Mode.
[/list]

So that's it for today's Devlog, stay tuned for further infos! Thank you for following this project!

Be safe and healthy,

Release schedule for 0.0.19 update which includes the features above:

October 26 for 20$+ Patrons
November 2 for 10$+ Patrons 
November 10 for 5$+ Patrons 
November 17 for 3$+ Patrons
November 20 on the market (Steam, itch.io, Gamejolt, DLSite etc.)
